flags.description: Although Carlsberg stopped production of its own Carlsberg- and Tuborg-branded beer in Russia after the 2022 invasion of Ukraine, other Carlsberg-owned brands continued to be sold there via its Baltika subsidiary; in July 2023 the Russian government seized Carlsberg's stake in Baltika under a decree targeting companies from 'unfriendly' countries, and Carlsberg only completed an exit sale in December 2024.
